draft_metadata.identity_reason: 原文 PDF 题名为 'Exploring optimal Taxol® CYP725A4 activity in Saccharomyces cerevisiae'，作者为 Behnaz Nowrouzi, Liang Lungang, Leonardo Rios‑Solis，期刊 Microbial Cell Factories 21:197 (2022)，DOI 10.1186/s12934-022-01922-1，与提供的 Zotero 元数据（key TMYGQMYW）完全一致。
draft_metadata.title_zh: 在酿酒酵母中探索紫杉醇® CYP725A4 的最佳活性
draft_metadata.classification_reason: 原文以'在酿酒酵母中系统性优化 CYP725A4 活性并提高氧化紫杉烷产量'为核心目标，使用合成生物学手段（基因剂量、自足融合、POR 串联、培养基筛选、DoE 辅因子优化、静息细胞反应）改造酵母细胞工厂。可归类为'细胞工厂—酿酒酵母—紫杉醇前体生产'，但任务提供的允许路径列表为空，因此 category=null 并如实标注真实学科方向。
source_gaps: Figure 6 各 panel 的 Venn 图每圆面积与具体百分比以数字标注于图内，本文据图复述，不另行估读；panel 顶部变量与存在正上方标注在图中按 Venn 圆顶端的 RIBOFLAVIN/FAD/HEMIN/ALA 等名称引用，不引申。
Figure 5A 内的拟合效应图为视觉读图，作者给出的是趋势和显著方向（p 值列于正文），未在正文中逐点列出系数。
Figure 8 图例严格列出 Diterpene I（绿色圆点）与 Diterpenoid I–IX 共 10 个带编号 novel 标签；论文 p.16 文字报告 'at least ten additional other oxygenated taxanes in both resting assays'，与图例一致。
Table 1 仅给出基因型，未给出复制数、整合位点序列或绝对质谱片段表；脚注 'The "L" represents the linker as listed in Additional file 1: Table S5' 提示各 BNF 自足融合菌株所用 L1–L7 连接肽序列列于补充材料 Table S5，主文未给出。

论文内部存在数值不一致：摘要与 p.17 结论段报告 'around 361.4±52.4 mg/L'，p.15 正文给出 pre-rest 实测终点 '354.6±51.1 mg/L'，而 p.16 又把 '361.4±52.4 mg/L' 归于 'post-rest stage'；摘要与 p.17 措辞模糊未指明诱导模式。本文在表格与结论中以 p.15 的 354.6±51.1 mg/L（pre-rest，115 h）作为可核验实测值，同时保留 361.4±52.4 mg/L 作为摘要/结论报告值，并以单句明确指出原文内部矛盾。
Figure 8 静息细胞时间序列只有 5 个时间点（21、28、50、98、115 h），Granger 因果检验样本量较小，多数因果 p 值处于 0.02–0.05 边界，可重复性需更大时间序列支持。
为完整保留全部图版与图注，截图扩展至页面 [0.08, 0.18, 1.0, 0.95]（Figure 6）、[0.07, 0.06, 0.95, 0.42]（Table 1），以保证 panel A–E 顶部变量标签 RIBOFLAVIN/FAD/ALA/HEMIN、Table 1 表体与脚注完全可见。

BNF-1 OCT 浓度原文未直接给出数值，本报告据 p.5 'reduction of 77.4- and 15.4-fold for T5α-ol and OCT...in comparison to BNF-1' 与 p.8 'represented 1.8-, 1.7-, 1.2-fold improvement compared to BNF-1' 反推得到约 7.9 mg/L（即 14.6/1.8 ≈ 8.1 mg/L 与 0.51×15.4 ≈ 7.85 mg/L 一致），并标注为基于原文算术的派生值，不当作自测值。

minor_issues.issue: 草稿在图注总结中将 Figure 8 图例的 10 个 novel 标签描述为 'Diterpene I（绿色圆点）与 Diterpenoid I–IX'，容易让读者误认为 'Diterpene I' 与 'Diterpenoid I' 是同一物质的不同写法；实际为两类不同化合物，但论文未给出化学结构区分。建议在最终报告中点名此命名歧义并注明其为作者原文措辞。

verified_claims.claim: 摘要报告的最高总紫杉烷 361.4±52.4 mg/L，包含 T5α-ol 38.1±8.4 mg/L，于 10 mL 静息细胞反应取得
verified_claims.evidence: 'the highest total taxanes of around 361.4 ± 52.4 mg/L including 38.1 ± 8.4 mg/L of T5α-ol was produced herein at a small, 10-mL scale by resting cell assay'

verified_claims.claim: pre-rest 115 h 实测总氧紫杉烷 354.6±51.1 mg/L (8.9±1.3 mg/L/OD600)；post-rest 220.5±34.2 mg/L (5.51±0.9 mg/L/OD600)
verified_claims.evidence: 'pre-rest galactose induction (354.6 ± 51.1 mg/L, 8.9 ± 1.3 mg/L/OD600) ... post-rest galactose induction (220.5 ± 34.2, 5.51 ± 0.9 mg/L/OD600)'

verified_claims.claim: BN6 在 YPG 72 h 终浓度：OCT 14.6±1.4 mg/L、iso-OCT 12±1.4 mg/L、T5α-ol 10.6±1.8 mg/L；taxadiene 20.3±0.9 mg/L；biomass 26.5±3.2
verified_claims.evidence: 'BN6 generated the highest amounts of OCT, iso-OCT and T5α-ol at the final concentrations of 14.6 ± 1.4, 12 ± 1.4 and 10.6 ± 1.8 mg/L ... taxadiene was almost doubled to be 20.3 ± 0.9 mg/L ... final biomass slightly reduced to 26.5 ± 3.2'

verified_claims.claim: BN5 仅 CYP725A4 株 T5α-ol 0.11±0.02 mg/L，OCT 0.51±0.2 mg/L，较 BNF-1 分别低 77.4 倍与 15.4 倍
verified_claims.evidence: 'produced T5α-ol, OCT and iso-OCT, although at minor quantities of 0.11 ± 0.02, 0.51 ± 0.2 mg/L ... represented a reduction of 77.4- and 15.4-fold for T5α-ol and OCT, respectively, in comparison to the strain BNF-1'

verified_claims.claim: DSD 中 ALA 对 OCT/iso-OCT/T5α-ol 显著负效应，p 值分别为 5.30e−05、2.2e−09、3.6e−10
verified_claims.evidence: 'ALA was a significant negative predictor (OCT: p-value = 5.30e−05; iso-OCT: p = 2.2e−09; T5α-ol: p = 3.6e−10)'

verified_claims.claim: 总细胞 ROS 与氧化紫杉烷相关性：OCT −0.28 (p=4.5e−05)、iso-OCT −0.17 (p=0.01)、T5α-ol −0.17 (p=0.01)
verified_claims.evidence: 'we did not observe any strong correlation (OCT: − 0.28, p = 4.5e−05; iso-OCT: − 0.17, p = 0.01; T5α-ol: − 0.17, p = 0.01) between total cellular ROS level and oxygenated taxanes'

verified_claims.claim: NaCl 1 mM 即显著降低 BN6 生物量；5 mM 时 OD600 归一化氧紫杉烷提升 1.4 倍，10 mM 时跌至 0.81±0.07 mg/L/OD600
verified_claims.evidence: 'the final biomass decreased as a result of increased ionic strength in as little as 1 mM, the overall oxygenated taxanes production per OD600 unit was found to increase by around 1.4-fold upon supplementing the exogenous NaCl concentration up to 5 mM, while a sudden drop to 0.81 ± 0.07 mg/L/OD600 was observed at 10 mM NaCl'

verified_claims.claim: T5α-ol:OCT:iso-OCT 比例在 BNF-1 为 1:0.89:0.81，BN6 为 1:1.4:1.1（72 h YPG）
verified_claims.evidence: 'the T5α-ol: OCT: iso-OCT ratio remained very similar, 1:0.89:0.81 and 1:1.4:1.1 for BNF-1 and BN6, respectively, by the end of 72-h cultivation in YPG medium'
